bindingPolicy: The local agent inventories existing voice assets/provider settings and binds these jobs to available approved voices. Null voice IDs are intentionally unbound; they are not API-ready credentials.

personas.label: The Network Voice
personas.delivery: Warm, confident regional television announcer. Medium-low register; clear American English; measured delivery. Light authority, not a movie-trailer growl. Finish titles cleanly.
personas.humor: Mostly sincere. An occasional understated final line.

personas.label: The Local Guy
personas.delivery: Friendly local independent-station announcer. Medium register, conversational American English, a little salesmanship, never shouting. A smile in the read, no forced sitcom laugh.
personas.humor: Small domestic observations; not a stand-up routine.

personas.label: The Overnight Voice
personas.delivery: Low-energy but clearly intelligible late-night announcer. Dry American delivery; lower-middle register; slight fatigue, not slurring or whispering. Let one short pause do the joke. Maintain normal audible volume.
personas.humor: Deadpan. The station is still running; the staff may not be.

personas.label: The Odd Promo Voice
personas.delivery: Quietly formal, slightly too precise station employee reading a mundane notice. Different timbre from the main voices. Strange through timing, not a cartoon monster. No celebrity imitation.
personas.humor: One odd observation, delivered without comment.
